1. body_mass_g was stored as text (one value "4,925" with a thousands separator) — cast to numbers; all 65 values parsed, none lost.
2. sex had a case variant "FEMALE" (row 42) — normalized to "female" so the group-by has two clean groups. No missing sex values.
3. Three rows (9, 20, 49) had body_mass_g of 3,700,000 / 3,550,000 / 5,950,000 g, far outside the rules range 2500–6500 g (likely unit errors) — excluded (approved).
4. One exact duplicate row (row 59) — removed (approved).

Caveats: the three excluded rows were dropped rather than corrected, since the rules file gives no conversion rule; if they were meant to be 3700/3550/5950 g they could be recomputed instead. Also noted but not used by this question: flipper_length_mm has one negative value (-181, row 1) outside the rules range 170–235 — it does not affect the body-mass averages.
